moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: Every child in America will receive two SpaceX shares, one from the company and one from me personally.
moments.why: A staggering pledge (~$18B worth) by Musk capturing major attention — a wild philanthropic gesture now trending.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: I will be donating another share of SpaceX to all kids in America every year
moments.why: Expands the share‑giving pledge into an annual program — keeps discussion rolling around his bold commitment.

moments.author: The U.S. Air Force (via Reuters reports)
moments.quote: Hackers breached the US Air Force’s flagship Cloud One computing platform.
moments.why: A major cyber‑security scare — breach of military cloud systems is alarming and driving urgent talk among men 25‑45.

moments.author: MotoGP / Circuit de Barcelona‑Catalunya
moments.quote: Marquez anuncia su retirada — el ‘bombazo’ que todos lamentan.
moments.why: MotoGP legend Marc Márquez retiring is a huge cultural moment for sports fans, especially men in their 30s‑40s.

moments.author: El País (via Marquez coverage)
moments.quote: “Mi cuerpo me obliga a vivir año a año, mes a mes, día a día” — Marquez on his emotional retirement.
moments.why: Marquez’s poignant reflection adds emotional weight to a career‑ending moment that’s resonating deeply right now.
